title: Petition of Robert's Limousine Service, Inc. pursuant to the provisions of G.L. c. 159, § 7, requesting a Certificate of Public Convenience and authorizing the operation of motor vehicles for the carriage of passengers for hire in restricted common carrier service in the Cities of Boston, Malden, Revere and Peabody and the Towns of Saugus, Lynnfield, Middleton and Danvers.
